question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution: The correct answer is **"assumed."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Assumed"** means to take for granted without proof or to suppose to be true. (प्रमाण न होते हुए भी किसी बात को सत्‍य मान लेना; किसी बात के सत्‍य होने की आशा या अपेक्षा करना) • **Example**: *I **assumed**__ that you had the necessary documents.* • Grammatically, it is the most appropriate option to fill the blank as it fits the context of the sentence. • The correct answer is Option 3. • **Correct passage**: Humans have __**assumed**__ that animals do not have a life and maybe exploited in any way they see fit, but this ______ (2) ______ is incorrect and must be altered before it is too late. We fail to recognise that the pain we ______ (3) ______ on animals will come back to haunt us, and no matter how ______ (4) ______ the discovery we make by causing harm to animals, it will be futile. It can never ______ (5) ______ the human actions.​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Option 1, **"assigned"**, means to give a particular task or duty to someone. (विशेष उद्देश्‍य से कुछ देना) • Option 2,** "claimed"**, means to assert or demand as a right. (बिना प्रमाण प्रस्‍तुत किए सत्‍यता का दावा करना) • Option 4, **"pretended"**, means to behave in a way that is not genuine or to feign. (प्रदर्शन, ढोंग या दिखावा करना) 3e:Te8e, The correct answer is **"perspective."**
